authority_basis.summary: Derive a nonfitted source-related dual-cutoff normalization for the Mellin-dilation Hilbert-Polya candidate.

operations.title: Pointed pi_0 and its dual fix the dual-cutoff scale without fitting
operations.statement: The conditional initial semiring supplies an ordered rank-one lattice with primitive positive generator and primitive positive dual functional, fixing x>=1, p>=1 and phase-cell covolume one. Under the explicit self-dual Fourier convention exp(-2*pi*i*x*p), 2*pi*hbar=1 and Mellin parameter t corresponds to phase energy E=t/(2*pi). The exact phase count is t/(2*pi)log(t/(2*pi))-t/(2*pi)+1, deriving the growing Riemann-von Mangoldt terms and scale without fitted cutoffs; the remaining constant defect is 1/8 and fluctuations are absent.
operations.scope: Conditional pointed pi_0 plus explicit archimedean Fourier realization; no self-adjoint dual-cutoff boundary, xi determinant, or zero spectrum.

operations.title: Unimodular phase-cell normalization test
operations.procedure: Construct the ordered group completion and primitive dual, compute lattice covolume, use the self-dual Fourier momentum normalization, and substitute E=t/(2*pi) into the exact dual-cutoff area.
operations.expected_result: The two growing Riemann-von Mangoldt terms agree without a fitted scale and the constant differs by exactly 1/8. Any scale parameter remaining after the stated inputs falsifies the claim.
